text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第1批 · 08 · 乡间旧宅的午后厨房.
Environment: A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: original northern Italian villa kitchen, summer afternoon with soft bright window light and generous reflected fill. Off-white handmade ceramic tiles, cream plaster, double deep ceramic sink below a large garden-facing window, three worn copper pans hanging from a modest oak rail, open wood shelves of plain dishes and glass jars. Foreground right shows corner of a scratched honey-brown preparation table with a folded flax towel, sliced bread and a bowl of pears, no knives as focal point. Rear doorway opens into a quiet ivory dining room, faded sage linen panel below counter. Simple functional cooking space with restrained believable untidiness, no luxury marble island, no showroom styling. Research inspiration: Call Me by Your Name's villa kitchen material vocabulary and lived-in domestic specificity; entirely new layout and props. Emotion: slow summer domestic life, warm and intimate.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第1批 · 08 · 乡间旧宅的午后厨房. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
